z1lr.note: PPO from a random network, no imitation. The evaluation games (GA base, bots) are only measured, never trained on, until a stage adds those opponents.

stages.name: self-play
stages.reward: +1 win, 0 shared win, -1 loss, at the end of the game only
stages.pass: no new best against the GA base (eval) for 60 iterations
stages.expect: From a random network to money play: buy Silver, Gold and Provinces, learned only from beating itself.

stages.name: bots
stages.world: opponents: itself 50%, own past snapshots 15%, the 3 bots 35%
stages.reward: +1 win, 0 shared win, -1 loss, at the end of the game only
stages.pass: eval against the bots at least 70%
stages.expect: Learns to punish the bots' fixed habits (Witch-BM's curses above all).

stages.name: league
stages.world: opponents: itself 25%, own past snapshots 15%, the 3 bots 10%, GA base genome 20%, rl-v1's nets 15%, az-v1 net 10%, az-v1 search 5%
stages.reward: +1 win, 0 shared win, -1 loss, at the end of the game only
stages.expect: Meets every earlier model; the target is rl-v1 (82% against the GA base, 72% against az-v1).
